backup.description: Events, profile, follows, media packs, favorites, and recoverable uploaded media. Private keys are never included.
backup.partial: Backup downloaded. {count} media file(s) could not be embedded; their URLs and Blossom hashes are still included.

activity.label: Show activity indicator
activity.description: Bottom-right notifications for login, signing, and relay publishing.

sounds.label: Notification sounds
sounds.description: Chime when someone mentions you, replies to you, or sends you a DM.

desktop.label: Browser notifications
desktop.description: System notifications for mentions, replies and DMs: they ring even when Obelisk is in another tab. Your browser asks for permission on your first click. DM text is never shown.
desktop.denied: Blocked in your browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser's site settings (the icon left of the address bar), then come back.

background.label: Listen on recent relays
background.description: Stay connected to the last 3 relays you used and notify you of mentions and replies there too.

clear.title: Clear local cache
clear.description: Wipes cached channels, profiles, branding, member lists, read positions, and DM cache. Live data re-streams from the relay on next paint. Your session and preferences are kept.

confirm.title: Clear local cache?
confirm.description: This wipes every locally-cached relay response (channels, profiles, branding, members, read positions, DM cache, UI flags) and reloads the page. Your session and preferences stay; you stay logged in.

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by the app UI.

directMessages.label: Direct messages
directMessages.description: Allow this device to open Nostr encrypted DM subscriptions and display conversations.
directMessages.mobileDescription: Nostr encrypted DMs on this device

profileFeed.title: Profile feed relays
profileFeed.description: Public Nostr relays for your feed and profiles. Cached locally for instant loading.
profileFeed.invalid: Enter three different valid wss:// relay URLs.

bubbleMotion.label: Bubble motion
bubbleMotion.description: Animation style for the decorative background bubbles

socialRelays.title: Feed relays
socialRelays.description: Public Nostr relays for your feed and profiles, separate from the group relays in the rail. Between 1 and 8.
socialRelays.importEmpty: No relay list found for your account.
socialRelays.invalid: Enter at least one valid wss:// relay URL.

profileEditor.setupDesc: Add a name and picture so others can recognize you.
profileEditor.nameRequiredHint: You need a name to continue. Tap the dice to generate one.
profileEditor.clickToUpload: Click to upload or drag & drop an image
profileEditor.invalidUrl: Could not load image from this URL
profileEditor.publishError: Failed to publish profile. Try again.
profileEditor.confirmDesc: This will publish your updated profile (kind 0) to Nostr relays. Your other profile fields (NIP-05, Lightning, etc.) will be preserved.

profile.label: Profile
profile.desc: Your name, picture, banner and links, published to Nostr as your kind-0 profile.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.desc: Accent, background, button and bubble colours.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.desc: Sounds, ringtone, browser notifications and background listening.

relays.label: Relays
relays.desc: The public relays your feeds and profiles are read from.

privacy.label: Privacy & safety
privacy.desc: Direct messages, post-quantum protection, muted and blocked people, and web of trust.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.desc: Backups, local data and developer tools.

postQuantumHint: Seal direct messages with post-quantum keys when you and the other person both have them and your signer can use them. Anything that cannot be sealed still sends, with ordinary encryption. While this is on, each conversation also shows whether it is quantum-safe.
postQuantumDetected: Post-quantum keys detected on this account.
postQuantumReady: Your signer can send post-quantum messages. While this setting is on, conversations with people who also publish post-quantum keys get the extra seal.
postQuantumSignerUnknown: Your signer does not report post-quantum support, so messages keep going out with ordinary encryption. Obelisk starts using post-quantum on its own once the signer reports it.
postQuantumNotDetected: No post-quantum keys detected on this account.

moderation.title: Muted & blocked
moderation.empty: You haven't muted or blocked anyone.

developer.title: Developer settings
developer.signatureHelp: Request mock signatures for every event kind Obelisk uses. Signed events are discarded and never published.
developer.relayLogsHelp: Log relay calls to the console.
developer.mockContent: Obelisk mock signature test for kind {kind}. This event is not published.

wot.title: Web of Trust
wot.help: Drop events authored by accounts outside your social graph before they reach the cache.
wot.hopsHelp: 1° = direct follows only · 2° = friends of follows · higher = wider net.
wot.pathsHelp: Require this many independent follow paths before trusting a pubkey. Higher values reject single-shill follows; only effective when the extension reports path counts.

calls.title: Calls
calls.fromHint: Calls from anyone else are ignored without ringing.
calls.ipHint: A direct call shows each side the other's IP address. Relaying through our TURN server hides it, at some cost in quality.
calls.relaysHint: Where the call is set up. They only ever see two throwaway keys exchanging encrypted data, so they must accept events from unknown keys: a whitelist relay can't carry a call.
